column1: # Key used: Hermann Stützel, "Chiffrierwesen im Dreißigjährigen Krieg", Württembergisch Franken 47 (1963) 109-115, Anlage 1 (group I, Ferdinand III to Hatzfeld 1641); DOI 10.53458/wfr.v47i.13761, CC BY 4.0.
# Stützel 1963 broke the system and printed this key; we do NOT claim it. Applied unchanged (SHA-256 of our transcription of the table: 57d24981...).
# token<TAB>value<TAB>sign (NUL = null). Token names are those of transcription_p*.txt. Glyph notes from the 1641 hands (not changes to the key; Stützel prints the Mars row as "v u"):
#   CROSSO (one loop + cross above) = u, distinct from TAU (8, two loops + cross above) = b; MER (Mercury) is written as an 8 with a cross below, VEN (Venus) as a single loop with a cross below.
